python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W,H=900,300

def make(path, show_action):
    img=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),(30,30,30))
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    # background panels
    d.rectangle([0,0,W,H],fill=(34,34,34))
    # crumb bar
    d.rectangle([0,0,W,70],fill=(50,50,50))
    # browser area
    d.rectangle([0,70,W,H],fill=(30,30,30))
    # path text
    try:
        font=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',26)
        small=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf',18)
    except:
        font=small=None
    d.text((20,18),'~/lib/Indie',fill=(220,220,220),font=font)
    # action area
    if show_action:
        # button
        bx=W-120
        by=10
        d.rounded_rectangle([bx,10,bx+90,60],radius=10,outline=(220,220,220),width=3,fill=(0,120,220))
        d.text((bx+30,22),'⊙',fill=(255,255,255),font=font)
        d.text((bx-10,62),'show row',fill=(200,200,200),font=small)
    else:
        d.text((W-250,30),'(no action)',fill=(180,180,180),font=small)

    # list items in browser region (only some visible)
    start_y=90
    row_h=26
    visible=7
    for i in range(visible):
        y=start_y+i*row_h
        d.rectangle([20,y,W-20,y+row_h-2],fill=(45,45,45),outline=(60,60,60))
        d.text((35,y+4),f'Track {i+0}',fill=(220,220,220),font=small)

    # indicate current playing track offscreen
    # draw marker at top edge
    d.polygon([(W/2-8,70),(W/2+8,70),(W/2,60)],fill=(255,180,0))
    d.text((W/2+20,65),'now-playing row offscreen',fill=(255,200,80),font=small)

    img.save(path)

make('docs/screenshots/void_screen_before.png',False)
make('docs/screenshots/void_screen_after.png',True)
print('wrote')
